aim: Separate reader capability from source-structure retrieval; test generic baselines before claiming a new comparison method.

reader_selection.selection_basis: Current official capability reports and executable CPU/memory feasibility, before v14 answers; not established stronger by card.
reader_selection.native_template: enable_thinking=false; exact rendered prompt/token IDs archived
reader_selection.decoding: greedy seed7; no repair or retry; fresh process per completion

competence_controls.gate: At least7/8 reference-complete grounded responses, no critical sign/unit/year/sample error in any answered control claim.
competence_controls.limitations: Pass permits a bounded development comparison; not a strong general reader certification.
competence_controls.failed_gate_policy: Preserve all outputs and do not run primary32-answer comparison as an adequate-reader study. Any changed prompt/model/control needs new frozen amendment and separate results.

shared_retrieval.corpus: Existing full550-page four-PDF corpus including previously verified two OPERA raster transcriptions
shared_retrieval.supplied_scope: Question-to-history membership and within-history version ordering supplied
shared_retrieval.query: Exact frozen question text, no answer labels
shared_retrieval.ranking: Existing BM25 defaults over frozen2306chunk corpus
shared_retrieval.closure: Seed text plus explicitly source-bound structural dependencies; generic evidence-closure baseline, not novel claim
shared_retrieval.packing: Whole bundles only, deterministic score order, skip overbudget bundle; no answer-aware backfill
shared_retrieval.actual_usage: Report native tokens and source words per condition; caps matched, actual usages can differ
shared_retrieval.rendering: Source version/page order and native within-span layout; exact spans/hashes archived
shared_retrieval.structural_audit: Must precede inference; false accepted attachment triggers fix/versioned repeat before predictions, unresolved and missing remain explicit. No invented units or continuation.

comparison_plan.within_question_order: Rotate four-condition order by question index, deterministic before output
comparison_plan.reader_only_check: Record whether ordinary/paired contexts equal v13 layout; report any packing differences. Model/template/quantization change jointly, not size-only causal claim.
comparison_plan.source_audit: Condition-masked exact-context review separate from answer grading
comparison_plan.grading: Reuse frozenv13 references/contract plus explicitv13 rounding adjudication; content/scope/citation/format/abstention separately
comparison_plan.summary: Descriptive8-question counts and perquestion outcomes. No statistical/generalization claim from two histories.
comparison_plan.stop: Do not enlarge or select conditions after seeing output.

research_hypothesis.proposed_not_tested: Retrieval of source witnesses that distinguish answer-changing scope/attachment alternatives
research_hypothesis.prior_art_boundary: Version filtering, structural closure, missing-slot retrieval, sufficiency and abstention already exist; these implemented baselines are not claimed inventions.
research_hypothesis.go_no_go: Only develop candidate mechanism further if adequate reader and generic structure leave a recurring source-grounded ambiguity on fresh histories.
research_hypothesis.required_future: History/entity-disjoint natural evaluation, pointer/slot/sufficiency/parent baselines, matched evidence and call budgets, candidate recall and failure analysis.
